name: VanEck Treasury Fund
collateral: Short-duration U.S. Treasury bills held by a BVI Professional Fund advised by Van Eck Associates; tokenization, transfer agency, and KYC by Securitize with State Street as fund administrator
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting institutional T-bill share token; instant mint and redemption at daily NAV through Securitize Markets against USDC, AUSD, or USD wire; Chainlink NAVLink oracle is integrated by Aave Horizon (oracle address not yet wired into Pharos)

proofOfReserves.provider: Securitize / Van Eck Associates (daily NAV and holdings disclosures)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Securitize operates VBILL with permissioned token transfers restricted to KYC-onboarded institutional holders and retains transfer-agent freeze and burn authority on behalf of Van Eck Associates.

notices.title: Securitize-administered NAV token
notices.message: VBILL is institutional only via Securitize Markets and also issues on Avalanche, BNB Chain, and Solana via Wormhole. Pharos currently tracks the Ethereum supply contract pending per-chain verification.
